title: Simulate Synchronous Layout Measure Hook
problemStatement: Implement `measureElementSynchronously(element, measureFn)` that executes `measureFn(element)` synchronously immediately after element attributes are written, guaranteeing that measurements occur before paint without flicker.
interviewTrap: Measuring in `useEffect` causes a visible flicker: the user sees the unstyled/unmeasured element for one frame before it repositions.

testCases.name: Synchronously measures element geometry
testCases.testFn: const el = document.createElement('div'); return measureElementSynchronously(el, r => ({ width: r.width, height: r.height }));

testCases.name: Computes derived layout position immediately
testCases.testFn: const el = document.createElement('div'); return measureElementSynchronously(el, r => r.width / 2);

testCases.name: Returns synchronously without promises or timeouts
testCases.testFn: let measured = false; const el = document.createElement('div'); measureElementSynchronously(el, () => { measured = true; }); return measured;

details.name: Returns synchronously without promises or timeouts

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: `useLayoutEffect` is specifically designed for synchronous DOM layout measurements (e.g. `getBoundingClientRect()`, tooltip positioning, scroll offset adjustments) before the browser paints. Because it runs synchronously before paint, mutating the DOM inside `useLayoutEffect` prevents visible visual flicker.
stepByStepWalkthrough: Inside layout phase (synchronously after simulated DOM creation):
- Compute derived positioning (e.g. tooltip coordinates: `top = rect.bottom + 8`).
- Return derived layout metrics synchronously without delays or promises.
Demonstrate that if this were done in `useEffect`, a frame would paint at old coordinates before jumping, causing a visible flicker.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: `useLayoutEffect` runs in the same synchronous turn as the commit phase. The browser's compositing and paint threads have not run yet. When `useLayoutEffect` updates state or modifies element styles, React performs an immediate synchronous sub-render before the browser renders pixels to the screen.

complexity.time: O(1) synchronous DOM query and calculation.

edgeCasesHandled: Returns synchronous layout position immediately without promises.
Calculates correct geometry based on element bounding rect.
